basis: net value added per SOURCE kWh; token vs electron / aluminium frontiers
interpretation: Token net value/source kWh exceeds the electron and aluminium pathways for almost the entire realistic price plane: even at a budget token price of a few cents per Mtoken, the breakeven token price needed to match the electron/aluminium net is far below today's market prices. The token pathway only loses if its price collapses to well under $0.1/Mtoken or on-site electricity becomes very expensive.
